   232	    {R A1 A2 B1 B2 D1 D2 : Type u}
   233	    [CommRing R] [CommRing A1] [CommRing A2]
   234	    [CommRing B1] [CommRing B2] [CommRing D1] [CommRing D2]
   235	    [Algebra R A1] [Algebra R A2]
   236	    [Algebra R B1] [Algebra R B2] [Algebra R D1] [Algebra R D2]

   238	    (f2 : A2 →ₐ[R] B2) (g2 : A2 →ₐ[R] D2)
   239	    (eA : A1 ≃ₐ[R] A2) (eB : B1 ≃ₐ[R] B2) (eD : D1 ≃ₐ[R] D2)
   240	    (hf : eB.toAlgHom.comp f1 = f2.comp eA.toAlgHom)
   241	    (hg : eD.toAlgHom.comp g1 = g2.comp eA.toAlgHom) :
   242	    letI : Algebra A1 B1 := f1.toRingHom.toAlgebra
   243	    letI : Algebra A1 D1 := g1.toRingHom.toAlgebra
   244	    letI : Algebra A2 B2 := f2.toRingHom.toAlgebra
   245	    letI : Algebra A2 D2 := g2.toRingHom.toAlgebra
   246	    letI : IsScalarTower R A1 B1 :=
   247	      IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq (fun x => (f1.commutes x).symm)
   248	    letI : IsScalarTower R A2 B2 :=
   249	      IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq (fun x => (f2.commutes x).symm)
   250	    (forall b : B1,

   252	          (b ⊗ₜ[A1] (1 : D1)) =
   253	        eB b ⊗ₜ[A2] (1 : D2)) ∧
   254	    (forall d : D1,
   255	      tensorPushoutAlgEquivCongr f1 g1 f2 g2 eA eB eD hf hg
   256	          ((1 : B1) ⊗ₜ[A1] d) =
   257	        (1 : B2) ⊗ₜ[A2] eD d) := by
   258	  letI : Algebra A1 B1 := f1.toRingHom.toAlgebra
   259	  letI : Algebra A1 D1 := g1.toRingHom.toAlgebra

   261	  letI : Algebra A2 D2 := g2.toRingHom.toAlgebra

   264	  letI : IsScalarTower R A2 B2 :=
   265	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq (fun x => (f2.commutes x).symm)

   267	  let P2 := B2 ⊗[A2] D2

   270	  let jD : D1 →+* P2 :=
   271	    Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom.comp eD.toRingEquiv.toRingHom
   272	  have ht : IsPushout
   273	      (CommRingCat.ofHom f1.toRingHom) (CommRingCat.ofHom g1.toRingHom)

   277	      eD.toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso (Iso.refl (CommRingCat.of P2))

/-! ## Tensor pushouts of descended restriction maps -/

/-- The algebra structure selected by an algebra map.  Naming it keeps the two finite-stage
restriction legs definitionally stable inside their tensor pushout. -/
@[reducible]
noncomputable def pic0FiniteStageAlgebraOfMap
    {R A B : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] (f : A →ₐ[R] B) : Algebra A B :=
  f.toRingHom.toAlgebra

/-- The ground-ring algebra, source algebra, and target algebra attached to an algebra map
form a scalar tower. -/
@[reducible]
noncomputable def pic0FiniteStageTowerOfMap
    {R A B : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] (f : A →ₐ[R] B) :
    letI : Algebra A B := pic0FiniteStageAlgebraOfMap f
    IsScalarTower R A B := by
  letI : Algebra A B := pic0FiniteStageAlgebraOfMap f
  exact IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq (fun r => (f.commutes r).symm)

/-- The tensor-pushout ring attached to two algebra maps with common source. -/
noncomputable def Pic0FiniteStageTensorPushoutRing
    {R A B₁ B₂ : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing A]
    [CommRing B₁] [CommRing B₂] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B₁] [Algebra R B₂]
    (f₁ : A →ₐ[R] B₁) (f₂ : A →ₐ[R] B₂) : Type u := by
  letI := pic0FiniteStageAlgebraOfMap f₁
  letI := pic0FiniteStageAlgebraOfMap f₂
  exact B₁ ⊗[A] B₂

noncomputable instance
    {R A B₁ B₂ : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing A]
    [CommRing B₁] [CommRing B₂] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B₁] [Algebra R B₂]
    (f₁ : A →ₐ[R] B₁) (f₂ : A →ₐ[R] B₂) :
    CommRing (Pic0FiniteStageTensorPushoutRing f₁ f₂) := by
  dsimp only [Pic0FiniteStageTensorPushoutRing]
  infer_instance

noncomputable instance
    {R A B₁ B₂ : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing A]
    [CommRing B₁] [CommRing B₂] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B₁] [Algebra R B₂]
    (f₁ : A →ₐ[R] B₁) (f₂ : A →ₐ[R] B₂) :
    Algebra R (Pic0FiniteStageTensorPushoutRing f₁ f₂) := by
  dsimp only [Pic0FiniteStageTensorPushoutRing]
  letI := pic0FiniteStageAlgebraOfMap f₁
  letI := pic0FiniteStageAlgebraOfMap f₂
  letI := pic0FiniteStageTowerOfMap f₁
  exact Algebra.TensorProduct.leftAlgebra

/-- A tensor pushout of two finite-type algebras is finite type over the common ground
ring. -/
theorem finiteType_pic0FiniteStageTensorPushoutRing
    {R A B₁ B₂ : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing A]
    [CommRing B₁] [CommRing B₂] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B₁] [Algebra R B₂]
    [Algebra.FiniteType R B₁] [Algebra.FiniteType R B₂]
    (f₁ : A →ₐ[R] B₁) (f₂ : A →ₐ[R] B₂) :
    Algebra.FiniteType R (Pic0FiniteStageTensorPushoutRing f₁ f₂) := by
  dsimp only [Pic0FiniteStageTensorPushoutRing]
  letI := pic0FiniteStageAlgebraOfMap f₁
  letI := pic0FiniteStageAlgebraOfMap f₂
  letI := pic0FiniteStageTowerOfMap f₁
  letI := pic0FiniteStageTowerOfMap f₂
  exact AlgebraicJacobian.finiteType_tensorProduct_over

/-- Scalar extension commutes with the tensor pushout attached to two algebra maps. -/
noncomputable def pic0FiniteStageTensorPushoutBaseChange
    {R K A B₁ B₂ : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing K]
    [CommRing A] [CommRing B₁] [CommRing B₂]
    [Algebra R K] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B₁] [Algebra R B₂]
    (f₁ : A →ₐ[R] B₁) (f₂ : A →ₐ[R] B₂) :
    letI : Algebra A B₁ := pic0FiniteStageAlgebraOfMap f₁
    letI : Algebra A B₂ := pic0FiniteStageAlgebraOfMap f₂
    letI : IsScalarTower R A B₁ := pic0FiniteStageTowerOfMap f₁
    letI : IsScalarTower R A B₂ := pic0FiniteStageTowerOfMap f₂
    let g₁ := AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMap
      (M := R) (K := K) (A := A) (B := B₁)
    let g₂ := AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMap
      (M := R) (K := K) (A := A) (B := B₂)
    letI : Algebra (K ⊗[R] A) (K ⊗[R] B₁) := g₁.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra (K ⊗[R] A) (K ⊗[R] B₂) := g₂.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    (K ⊗[R] (B₁ ⊗[A] B₂)) ≃ₐ[K]
      ((K ⊗[R] B₁) ⊗[K ⊗[R] A] (K ⊗[R] B₂)) := by
  letI : Algebra A B₁ := pic0FiniteStageAlgebraOfMap f₁
  letI : Algebra A B₂ := pic0FiniteStageAlgebraOfMap f₂
  letI : IsScalarTower R A B₁ := pic0FiniteStageTowerOfMap f₁
  letI : IsScalarTower R A B₂ := pic0FiniteStageTowerOfMap f₂
  exact AlgebraicJacobian.tensorProductPushoutBaseChange
    (M := R) (K := K) (A := A) (B₁ := B₁) (B₂ := B₂)

/-- The descended model of the coordinate ring of a chart. -/
abbrev Pic0FiniteStageChartModelRing
    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k]
    (L : DatG0.FinSubext F k)
    (n m : Pic0FiniteStageRingIndex C → ℕ)
    (relation : ∀ j, Fin (m j) → MvPolynomial (Fin (n j)) L.1)
    (M : DatG0.FinSubext L.1 k)
    (U : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) : Type u :=
  Pic0FiniteStageModelRing C L n m relation M (Sum.inl U)

/-- The descended model of the coordinate ring of an ordered pair-overlap. -/
abbrev Pic0FiniteStageOverlapModelRing
    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k]
    (L : DatG0.FinSubext F k)
    (n m : Pic0FiniteStageRingIndex C → ℕ)
    (relation : ∀ j, Fin (m j) → MvPolynomial (Fin (n j)) L.1)
    (M : DatG0.FinSubext L.1 k)
    (U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) : Type u :=
  Pic0FiniteStageModelRing C L n m relation M (Sum.inr (U, V))

/-- The descended left restriction leg selected from the simultaneous map family. -/
noncomputable abbrev pic0FiniteStageRestrictionLeftModel
    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k]
    (L : DatG0.FinSubext F k)
    (n m : Pic0FiniteStageRingIndex C → ℕ)
    (relation : ∀ j, Fin (m j) → MvPolynomial (Fin (n j)) L.1)
    (M : DatG0.FinSubext L.1 k)
    (mapM : ∀ q : Pic0FiniteStageMapIndex C,
      Pic0FiniteStageModelRing C L n m relation M
          (Pic0FiniteStageMapSource C q) →ₐ[M.1]
        Pic0FiniteStageModelRing C L n m relation M
          (Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget C q))
    (U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
    Pic0FiniteStageChartModelRing C L n m relation M U →ₐ[M.1]
      Pic0FiniteStageOverlapModelRing C L n m relation M U V :=
  mapM (Sum.inl (Sum.inl (U, V)))

/-- The descended triple-overlap ring: the tensor pushout of the two descended overlap
rings over their common left-chart model. -/
noncomputable abbrev Pic0FiniteStageTripleModelRing
    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k]
    (L : DatG0.FinSubext F k)
    (n m : Pic0FiniteStageRingIndex C → ℕ)
    (relation : ∀ j, Fin (m j) → MvPolynomial (Fin (n j)) L.1)
    (M : DatG0.FinSubext L.1 k)
    (mapM : ∀ q : Pic0FiniteStageMapIndex C,
      Pic0FiniteStageModelRing C L n m relation M
          (Pic0FiniteStageMapSource C q) →ₐ[M.1]
        Pic0FiniteStageModelRing C L n m relation M
          (Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget C q))
    (U V W : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) : Type u :=
  Pic0FiniteStageTensorPushoutRing
    (pic0FiniteStageRestrictionLeftModel C L n m relation M mapM U V)
    (pic0FiniteStageRestrictionLeftModel C L n m relation M mapM U W)

set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
-- The dependent finite-presentation models elaborate through the tensor-pushout theorem.
/-- Every descended triple-overlap model is finite type over its finite-stage field. -/
theorem finiteType_pic0FiniteStageTripleModelRing
    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k]
    (L : DatG0.FinSubext F k)
    (n m : Pic0FiniteStageRingIndex C → ℕ)
    (relation : ∀ j, Fin (m j) → MvPolynomial (Fin (n j)) L.1)
    (M : DatG0.FinSubext L.1 k)
    (mapM : ∀ q : Pic0FiniteStageMapIndex C,
      Pic0FiniteStageModelRing C L n m relation M
          (Pic0FiniteStageMapSource C q) →ₐ[M.1]
        Pic0FiniteStageModelRing C L n m relation M
          (Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget C q))
    (U V W : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
    Algebra.FiniteType M.1
      (Pic0FiniteStageTripleModelRing C L n m relation M mapM U V W) := by
  apply finiteType_pic0FiniteStageTensorPushoutRing

set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
-- The dependent finite-presentation models must elaborate through both tensor factors.
/-- Scalar extension from the common finite subextension to the separably closed field
commutes with the descended triple-overlap tensor pushout. -/
noncomputable def pic0FiniteStageTripleModelBaseChange
    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k]
    (L : DatG0.FinSubext F k)
    (n m : Pic0FiniteStageRingIndex C → ℕ)
    (relation : ∀ j, Fin (m j) → MvPolynomial (Fin (n j)) L.1)
    (M : DatG0.FinSubext L.1 k)
    (mapM : ∀ q : Pic0FiniteStageMapIndex C,
      Pic0FiniteStageModelRing C L n m relation M
          (Pic0FiniteStageMapSource C q) →ₐ[M.1]
        Pic0FiniteStageModelRing C L n m relation M
          (Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget C q))
    (U V W : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :=
  pic0FiniteStageTensorPushoutBaseChange (K := k)
    (pic0FiniteStageRestrictionLeftModel C L n m relation M mapM U V)
    (pic0FiniteStageRestrictionLeftModel C L n m relation M mapM U W)

end

   287	    apply (CommRingCat.isPushout_tensorProduct A2 B2 D2).of_iso'
   288	      eA.toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso eB.toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso
   289	      eD.toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso (Iso.refl (CommRingCat.of P2))
   290	    · ext x
   291	      exact DFunLike.congr_fun hf.symm x
   292	    · ext x
   293	      exact DFunLike.congr_fun hg.symm x
   294	    · rfl
   295	    · rfl
   296	  have hs : IsPushout
   297	      (CommRingCat.ofHom f1.toRingHom) (CommRingCat.ofHom g1.toRingHom)
   298	      (CommRingCat.ofHom (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom
   299	        (R := A1) (A := B1) (B := D1)))
   300	      (CommRingCat.ofHom (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight
   301	        (R := A1) (A := B1) (B := D1)).toRingHom) :=
   302	    CommRingCat.isPushout_tensorProduct A1 B1 D1
   303	  let ie : CommRingCat.of P1 ≅ CommRingCat.of P2 :=
   304	    hs.isoIsPushout (CommRingCat.of B1) (CommRingCat.of D1) ht
   305	  constructor
   306	  · intro b
   307	    change ie.hom.hom (b ⊗ₜ[A1] (1 : D1)) = eB b ⊗ₜ[A2] (1 : D2)
   308	    have hleft := hs.inl_isoIsPushout_hom
   309	      (CommRingCat.of B1) (CommRingCat.of D1) ht
   310	    have hx := congrArg
   311	      (fun q : CommRingCat.of B1 ⟶ CommRingCat.of P2 => q.hom b) hleft
   312	    change ie.hom.hom (b ⊗ₜ[A1] (1 : D1)) = jB b at hx
   313	    exact hx
   314	  · intro d
   315	    change ie.hom.hom ((1 : B1) ⊗ₜ[A1] d) = (1 : B2) ⊗ₜ[A2] eD d
   316	    have hright := hs.inr_isoIsPushout_hom
   317	      (CommRingCat.of B1) (CommRingCat.of D1) ht
   318	    have hx := congrArg
   319	      (fun q : CommRingCat.of D1 ⟶ CommRingCat.of P2 => q.hom d) hright
   320	    change ie.hom.hom ((1 : B1) ⊗ₜ[A1] d) = jD d at hx
   321	    exact hx

     8	/-!
     9	# Maps through a tower of scalar extensions
    10	
    11	This file isolates the elementary algebra behind finite-stage maps.  An algebra map can
    12	be extended along a scalar map, and the cancellation equivalence for a tower identifies
    13	that extension with any ambient map which commutes with the direct scalar extension.
    14	-/

    26	/-- Scalar extension of an algebra map.  This is the map-level form of
    27	`scalarExtensionMap`, whose special case induced by an algebra structure is recorded
    28	separately in the pushout base-change file. -/
    29	def scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom {R K A B : Type u}
    30	    [CommRing R] [CommRing K] [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    31	    [Algebra R K] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B]
    32	    (f : A →ₐ[R] B) :
    33	    (K ⊗[R] A) →ₐ[K] (K ⊗[R] B) :=
    34	  Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id K K) f
    35	
    36	/-- `scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom` sends a pure tensor by applying the original map to
    37	its algebra factor. -/
    38	@[simp]
    39	theorem scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom_tmul {R K A B : Type u}
    40	    [CommRing R] [CommRing K] [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    41	    [Algebra R K] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B]
    42	    (f : A →ₐ[R] B) (c : K) (a : A) :
    43	    scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom (R := R) (K := K) f (c ⊗ₜ[R] a) =
    44	      c ⊗ₜ[R] f a := by
    45	  simp [scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom]
    46	
    47	/-- Scalar extension of a map is natural in a tower of scalar rings. -/
    48	theorem scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom_tower {F L K A B : Type u}
    49	    [CommRing F] [CommRing L] [CommRing K] [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    50	    [Algebra F L] [Algebra F K] [Algebra L K] [IsScalarTower F L K]
    51	    [Algebra F A] [Algebra F B]
    52	    (f : A →ₐ[F] B) :
    53	    (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom F L K)
    54	        (AlgHom.id F B)).comp
    55	        ((scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom (R := F) (K := L) f).restrictScalars F) =
    56	      ((scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom (R := F) (K := K) f).restrictScalars F).comp
    57	        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom F L K)
    58	          (AlgHom.id F A)) := by
    59	  ext x
    60	  · simp [scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom]
    61	  · simp [scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom]
    62	
    63	/-- Scalar extension preserves composition of algebra maps. -/
    64	@[simp]
    65	theorem scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom_comp {R K A B D : Type u}
    66	    [CommRing R] [CommRing K] [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing D]
    67	    [Algebra R K] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] [Algebra R D]
    68	    (f : A →ₐ[R] B) (g : B →ₐ[R] D) :
    69	    (scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom (R := R) (K := K) g).comp
    70	        (scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom (R := R) (K := K) f) =
    71	      scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom (R := R) (K := K) (g.comp f) := by
    72	  ext x
    73	  · simp [scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom]
    74	
    75	/-- Scalar extension preserves the identity algebra map. -/
    76	@[simp]
    77	theorem scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom_id {R K A : Type u}
    78	    [CommRing R] [CommRing K] [CommRing A]
    79	    [Algebra R K] [Algebra R A] :
    80	    scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom (R := R) (K := K) (AlgHom.id R A) =
    81	      AlgHom.id K (K ⊗[R] A) := by
    82	  ext x
    83	  · simp [scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom]
    84	
    85	/-- Cancellation on a tensor whose right factor is itself a scalar extension. -/
    86	theorem cancelBaseChange_tmul_baseChange {F L K A : Type u}
    87	    [CommRing F] [CommRing L] [CommRing K] [CommRing A]
    88	    [Algebra F L] [Algebra F K] [Algebra L K] [IsScalarTower F L K]
    89	    [Algebra F A] (c : K) (x : L ⊗[F] A) :
    90	    Algebra.TensorProduct.cancelBaseChange F L K K A (c ⊗ₜ[L] x) =
    91	      c • Algebra.TensorProduct.map
    92	        (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom F L K) (AlgHom.id F A) x := by
    93	  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    94	  | zero => simp
    95	  | add x y hx hy =>
    96	      rw [TensorProduct.tmul_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, smul_add]
    97	  | tmul l a =>
    98	      simp [Algebra.TensorProduct.cancelBaseChange_tmul, Algebra.smul_def, mul_comm]
    99	
   100	/-- Cancellation is natural for maps between two base changes from `F` to `L` which
   101	commute with their direct scalar extensions from `L` to `K`. -/
   102	theorem cancelBaseChange_naturality {F L K A B : Type u}
   103	    [CommRing F] [CommRing L] [CommRing K] [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
   104	    [Algebra F L] [Algebra F K] [Algebra L K] [IsScalarTower F L K]
   105	    [Algebra F A] [Algebra F B]
   106	    (phiL : L ⊗[F] A →ₐ[L] L ⊗[F] B)
   107	    (phiK : K ⊗[F] A →ₐ[K] K ⊗[F] B)
   108	    (hphi :
   109	      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom F L K) (AlgHom.id F B)).comp
   110	          (phiL.restrictScalars F) =
   111	        (phiK.restrictScalars F).comp
   112	          (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom F L K) (AlgHom.id F A))) :
   113	    (Algebra.TensorProduct.cancelBaseChange F L K K B).toAlgHom.comp
   114	        (scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom (R := L) (K := K) phiL) =
   115	      phiK.comp (Algebra.TensorProduct.cancelBaseChange F L K K A).toAlgHom := by
   116	  apply DFunLike.ext _ _
   117	  intro x
   118	  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
   119	  | zero => simp
   120	  | add x y hx hy => simp [map_add, hx, hy]
   121	  | tmul c x =>
   122	      change Algebra.TensorProduct.cancelBaseChange F L K K B
   123	          (scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom (R := L) (K := K) phiL (c ⊗ₜ[L] x)) =
   124	        phiK (Algebra.TensorProduct.cancelBaseChange F L K K A (c ⊗ₜ[L] x))
   125	      rw [scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom_tmul, cancelBaseChange_tmul_baseChange,
   126	        cancelBaseChange_tmul_baseChange]
   127	      rw [show phiK (c • (Algebra.TensorProduct.map
   128	          (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom F L K) (AlgHom.id F A)) x) =
   129	          c • phiK ((Algebra.TensorProduct.map
   130	            (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom F L K) (AlgHom.id F A)) x) from
   131	        phiK.toLinearMap.map_smul c _]
   132	      have h := DFunLike.congr_fun hphi x
   133	      change
   134	        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom F L K) (AlgHom.id F B))
   135	            (phiL x) =
   136	          phiK ((Algebra.TensorProduct.map (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom F L K)
   137	            (AlgHom.id F A)) x) at h
   138	      exact congrArg (fun z => c • z) h
   139

   112	-- The quotient presentation creates a dependent module instance for every ring tag.
   113	/-- The chosen finite-presentation model ring at a further finite subextension. -/
   114	abbrev Pic0FiniteStageModelRing
   115	    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k]
   116	    (L : DatG0.FinSubext F k)
   117	    (n m : Pic0FiniteStageRingIndex C → ℕ)

   119	    (M : DatG0.FinSubext L.1 k)

   125	-- Both dependent tensor-product instances must elaborate before the conjugated map.
   126	/-- The exact combined-family map transported to the ambient tensor-product models. -/
   127	noncomputable def pic0FiniteStageTransportedMap
   128	    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k]
   129	    (L : DatG0.FinSubext F k)
   130	    (n m : Pic0FiniteStageRingIndex C → ℕ)
   131	    (relation : ∀ j, Fin (m j) → MvPolynomial (Fin (n j)) L.1)
   132	    (e : ∀ j,
   133	      k ⊗[L.1] DatG0.FiniteRelationAlgebra L.1 (n j) (m j) (relation j) ≃ₐ[k]
   134	        Pic0FiniteStageRing C j)
   135	    (q : Pic0FiniteStageMapIndex C) :
   136	    k ⊗[L.1] DatG0.FiniteRelationAlgebra L.1
   137	        (n (Pic0FiniteStageMapSource C q))
   138	        (m (Pic0FiniteStageMapSource C q))
   139	        (relation (Pic0FiniteStageMapSource C q)) →ₐ[k]

   141	        (n (Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget C q))

   143	        (relation (Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget C q)) :=
   144	  (e (Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget C q)).symm.toAlgHom.comp

   149	-- The source and target quotient algebras depend on the ordered chart pair.
   150	/-- The transported ambient transitions in opposite directions are inverse. -/
   151	theorem pic0FiniteStageTransportedTransition_inverse
   152	    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k]
   153	    (L : DatG0.FinSubext F k)
   154	    (n m : Pic0FiniteStageRingIndex C → ℕ)
   155	    (relation : ∀ j, Fin (m j) → MvPolynomial (Fin (n j)) L.1)
   156	    (e : ∀ j,
   157	      k ⊗[L.1] DatG0.FiniteRelationAlgebra L.1 (n j) (m j) (relation j) ≃ₐ[k]
   158	        Pic0FiniteStageRing C j)
   159	    (U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
   160	    (pic0FiniteStageTransportedMap C L n m relation e (Sum.inr (V, U))).comp
   161	        (pic0FiniteStageTransportedMap C L n m relation e (Sum.inr (U, V))) =
   162	      AlgHom.id k
   163	        (k ⊗[L.1] DatG0.FiniteRelationAlgebra L.1
   164	          (n (Sum.inr (V, U))) (m (Sum.inr (V, U)))
   165	          (relation (Sum.inr (V, U)))) := by
   166	  change
   167	    ((e (Sum.inr (V, U))).symm.toAlgHom.comp
   168	        ((pic0FiniteStageTransition C (V, U)).comp
   169	          (e (Sum.inr (U, V))).toAlgHom)).comp
   170	        ((e (Sum.inr (U, V))).symm.toAlgHom.comp
   171	          ((pic0FiniteStageTransition C (U, V)).comp
   172	            (e (Sum.inr (V, U))).toAlgHom)) = _
   173	  apply DFunLike.ext _ _
   174	  intro x
   175	  change
   176	    (e (Sum.inr (V, U))).symm
   177	      (pic0FiniteStageTransition C (V, U)
   178	        ((e (Sum.inr (U, V)))
   179	          ((e (Sum.inr (U, V))).symm
   180	            (pic0FiniteStageTransition C (U, V)
   181	              ((e (Sum.inr (V, U))) x))))) = x
   182	  rw [(e (Sum.inr (U, V))).apply_symm_apply]
   183	  have htransition :=
   184	    DFunLike.congr_fun (pic0FiniteStageTransition_inverse C U V)
   185	      ((e (Sum.inr (V, U))) x)
   186	  calc
   187	    _ = (e (Sum.inr (V, U))).symm ((e (Sum.inr (V, U))) x) := by
   188	      exact congrArg (e (Sum.inr (V, U))).symm htransition

section CommSemiring
variable [CommSemiring R]
variable [CommSemiring A] [Algebra R A]
variable [CommSemiring B] [Algebra R B]

instance instCommSemiring : CommSemiring (A ⊗[R] B) where
  toSemiring := inferInstance
  mul_comm x y := by
    refine TensorProduct.induction_on x ?_ ?_ ?_
    · simp
    · intro a₁ b₁
      refine TensorProduct.induction_on y ?_ ?_ ?_
      · simp
      · intro a₂ b₂
        simp [mul_comm]
      · intro a₂ b₂ ha hb
        simp [mul_add, add_mul, ha, hb]
    · intro x₁ x₂ h₁ h₂
      simp [mul_add, add_mul, h₁, h₂]

end CommSemiring

section Ring
variable [CommSemiring R]
variable [Ring A] [Algebra R A]
variable [Semiring B] [Algebra R B]

instance instRing : Ring (A ⊗[R] B) where
  toSemiring := instSemiring
  __ := TensorProduct.addCommGroup
  __ := instNonAssocRing

theorem intCast_def' {B} [Ring B] [Algebra R B] (z : ℤ) : (z : A ⊗[R] B) = (1 : A) ⊗ₜ (z : B) := by
  rw [intCast_def, ← zsmul_one, smul_tmul, zsmul_one]

-- verify there are no diamonds
example : (instRing : Ring (A ⊗[R] B)).toAddCommGroup = addCommGroup := by
  with_reducible_and_instances rfl
-- fails at `with_reducible_and_instances rfl` https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/issues/10906
example : (Ring.toIntAlgebra _ : Algebra ℤ (ℤ ⊗[ℤ] A)) = leftAlgebra := rfl

end Ring

section CommRing
variable [CommSemiring R]
variable [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
variable [CommSemiring B] [Algebra R B]

instance instCommRing : CommRing (A ⊗[R] B) :=
  { toRing := inferInstance
    mul_comm := mul_comm }

end CommRing

section RightAlgebra

variable [CommSemiring R]
variable [Semiring A] [Algebra R A]
variable [CommSemiring B] [Algebra R B]

/-- `S ⊗[R] T` has a `T`-algebra structure. This is not a global instance or else the action of
`S` on `S ⊗[R] S` would be ambiguous. -/
abbrev rightAlgebra : Algebra B (A ⊗[R] B) :=
  includeRight.toRingHom.toAlgebra' fun b x => by
    suffices LinearMap.mulLeft R (includeRight b) = LinearMap.mulRight R (includeRight b) from
      congr($this x)
    ext xa xb
    simp [mul_comm]

attribute [local instance] TensorProduct.rightAlgebra

lemma algebraMap_eq_includeRight :
    letI := rightAlgebra (R := R) (A := A) (B := B)
    algebraMap B (A ⊗[R] B) = includeRight (R := R) (A := A) (B := B) := rfl

instance right_isScalarTower : IsScalarTower R B (A ⊗[R] B) :=
  IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun r => (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.commutes r).symm

lemma right_algebraMap_apply (b : B) : algebraMap B (A ⊗[R] B) b = 1 ⊗ₜ b := rfl

instance : SMulCommClass A B (A ⊗[R] B) where
